howto: Press Play to face the next critter on the ladder, or pick Two players.
Tap a column (or drag along the board and let go): your disc drops to the lowest free hole.
Four in a row across, down or diagonally wins the round. Win two rounds before your opponent (three rounds at most).
Win 2 to 0 for three stars. Beat a critter to unlock the next one.
tips: The middle column is part of the most possible fours: start there.
Before you drop, check the hole above your disc: could it hand the other player a win?
Build two threats at once; your opponent can only block one.
You get 2 hints per match: use them when a four looks close.
Undo takes back your move and the critter's reply.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 7 drop in a column, or Tab/Left/Right then Enter. Z undoes, H hints. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a column, or slide along the board and lift your finger. Undo, Hint and Menu sit under the board.

difficulty: A six-critter ladder: Mousey plays almost at random, Bunny always takes wins and blocks yours, Kitty looks 3 moves ahead, Foxy 5, Owl 7 and the Dragon boss 9. Two-player mode is always available.

cheats.effect: The CPU naps: you move twice, three times
X-ray: a yellow ring shows the column the CPU wants

features.rules-screen: The How-to card (title, Pause > How to play) lists the rules; the first match has coach notes
features.ai-difficulty: Six critters from a random player to a nine-move search
features.undo: Undo button (Z key) takes back your move and the critter's reply; in Two players one move at a time
features.hints: Hint (2 per match, H key): rings the column that wins, blocks or builds the best position
features.level-select-or-daily: The Ladder: six critters, three stars each, each one unlocking the next
features.results: Round banners with a gold line through the winning four; a match card with stars, round score and XP
features.tutorial: First match: coach notes teach the drop and the four-in-a-row goal; skippable, replayed from How to play
features.progression: 6 opponents x 3 stars; XP levels unlock 6 disc sets (enamel, wood and ivory, marble tavern, emerald, neon, gold and silver); 3 daily goals and a weekly stamp chest
